{
  "name": "@egr/egr-app",
  "type": "module",
  "files": [
    "dist/*",
    "src/*"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "start": "vite",
    "build:development": "VITE_PREVIEW_BANNER=true vite build --mode development",
    "build:production": "VITE_PREVIEW_BANNER=true vite build --mode production",
    "build:staging": "VITE_PREVIEW_BANNER=true vite build --mode staging",
    "test": "LC_ALL=de-DE.utf8 vitest run",
    "test:smoke": "playwright test --config playwright.smoke.config.ts",
    "format": "f() { prettier --ignore-unknown --check ${@:-.}; }; f",
    "format-fix": "f() { prettier --ignore-unknown --write ${@:-.}; }; f",
    "format-list": "f() { prettier --ignore-unknown --list-different ${@:-.}; }; f",
    "type-check": "tsc",
    "lint": "oxlint --deny-warnings --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern",
    "lint-fix": "oxlint --fix --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern",
    "stylelint": "f() { stylelint ${@:-\"src/**/*.css\"}; }; f",
    "posthog:schema:status": "posthog-cli exp schema status",
    "posthog:schema:pull": "posthog-cli exp schema pull",
    "audit-licenses": "license-checker-rseidelsohn --onlyAllow=$(tr '\n' ';' < ./allowed-licenses) --clarificationsFile ./license-clarifications.json --excludePackages='@egr/egr-app@1.1.2' --out /dev/null"
  },

  },

    "@types/node": "^26.1.1",

    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^6.0.4",
